examples.title: Diamond Rings
examples.description: All sixteen C64 colours as diamond rings, poked a cell at a time into screen memory at 1024 and colour memory at 55296 (BASIC V2 has no graphics commands); it takes about half a minute, then press any key to finish.

examples.title: Border Colours
examples.description: Type a colour number from 0 to 15 and the program POKEs it into the VIC-II's border register at 53280 and tells you its name; -1 stops.

examples.title: Quick Draw
examples.description: Wait for the screen to turn red, then press a key as fast as you can; BASIC times you with its jiffy clock, and a key pressed too early is a false start.

manuals.title: Commodore 64 User's Guide
manuals.note: The manual that came in the box: setting up, the keyboard, and BASIC from the first PRINT. PDF scan.

manuals.title: Commodore 64 Programmer's Reference Guide
manuals.note: Every BASIC V2 keyword, the memory map, the VIC-II, the SID and machine code. PDF scan of the 1984 printing.
